chunks: Concerning a man who does not know whether he has prayed two rak'ahs or one, he said: “He completes his salat.” The first point regarding these reports is that they do not conflict with the reports we presented earlier, because they are fewer than those, and it is not permissible to turn away from the greater number to the lesser except with evidence. Even if these reports were opposed to them and equal to them, there would still be nothing in them that invalidates what we have presented, because there is nothing in any of these reports stating that the doubt occurred in the first and second rak'ahs of the obligatory salat or the supererogatory salat. If that is not stated in the report, we interpret them as referring to the nawafil, because according to us there is no sahw in the nawafil, and a person may build on the lesser number if he wishes and on the greater number if he wishes, though building on the lesser is preferable. Whenever we interpret these reports according to what we have mentioned, we have reconciled them all together and have not discarded anything from them. Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Whoever is forgetful in the obligatory salat of al-ghadah or al-maghrib must repeat. That is indicated by what he narrated:
And what Sa'd also narrated from Abi Ja'far, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala', from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام: regarding

key_terms.السَّهْوِ: forgetfulness or inadvertent error in salat
key_terms.الشَّكَّ: doubt regarding the number of rak'ahs
key_terms.الْأَخْبَارِ: the hadith reports being compared and reconciled
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the maghrib prayer specifically mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: two rak'ahs of salat being counted or doubted
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat, the prayer under discussion

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling when someone doubts the number of rak'ahs in obligatory or supererogatory salat?
ai.summary: This passage discusses legal reasoning concerning doubt in the number of rak'ahs in salat and reconciles apparently differing hadith reports. It states that reports allowing continuation are understood to concern nawafil, while doubt in certain obligatory prayers such as al-ghadah and al-maghrib requires repetition.
